items.title: George "Pops" Foster Interview, 1958-08-24
items.q: Then we got Babe Ridgely of the original Tuxi. The original Tuxi, the band. Still living too. Yeah, she had him on the trombone.

ctx.x: Yeah. But you know I drink the whiskey. A glass of ice more. Yeah, I get it. Yeah, that's all right.

Yeah. That's all right. Yeah. That's all right. Yeah. So we had them on the boat, see. Then we got Babe Ridgely of the original Tuxi. The original Tuxi, the band. Still living too. Yeah, she had him on the trombone. Well while she was working at a grocery store and he couldn't get off so I had a guy called August Russo playing trombone. I've never met him. See. Then by the time I, this guy Alexander, James Alexander, he wanted to go off with a show. He didn't want the boat jobs. That's when I went and got Baby…
Yeah, I know Baby told me that you got him on the job.
